mutations.label: QD4 THE TICKET: back to the bare slice-join, so the #1203b0 note again says '17 entry(ies) were KEPT' and lists eight -- and that note exists because a lane concluded it had fixed the blocker 19 times over
mutations.find:
% (len(_kept), _jc1203qd([str(a) for a in _kept],
                                                 total=len(_kept), cap=8, sep=", "))),
